welcome.title: JapaLife
welcome.lead: Hustle in Lagos, sort your papers, japa, and build a life abroad.
welcome.disclaimerHeading: This is a game, not immigration advice
disclaimer: Fees, rules, waiting times and prices in JapaLife are simplified, can be out of date, and some are made up for gameplay. Never use them to plan a real move.
For real decisions, use official sources only: **gov.uk** for the UK and **canada.ca** for Canada. Nobody can genuinely guarantee you a visa, so treat any agent who promises one as a scam.
welcome.ageQuestion: JapaLife is for players aged 18 and over. Are you 18 or older?
welcome.underage: Sorry, JapaLife is only for players aged 18 and over.
